definitions.explanation: Fish cooked by simmering in a broth typically made with soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar. A staple of traditional Japanese home cooking.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{夕飯|ゆうはん}は{煮魚|にざかな}だ。
{母|はは}の{作|つく}る{煮魚|にざかな}が{一番|いちばん}おいしい。
examples.english: My mother's simmered fish is the best.

examples.japanese: {定食屋|ていしょくや}で{煮魚|にざかな}{定食|ていしょく}を{注文|ちゅうもん}したら、{金目鯛|きんめだい}の{煮付|につ}けが{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: When I ordered the simmered fish set meal at the restaurant, they served simmered golden-eye snapper.

notes:
USAGE:
A classic component of Japanese home cooking ({家庭料理|かていりょうり}). Common fish used for {煮魚|にざかな} include {鯖|さば} (mackerel), {鰈|かれい} (flounder), and {金目鯛|きんめだい} (golden-eye snapper). The cooking method is called {煮付|につ}け.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煮魚|にざかな}{定食|ていしょく} (simmered fish set meal)
- {煮魚|にざかな}を{作|つく}る (to make simmered fish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}: grilled fish — another staple of Japanese cuisine
- {煮付|につ}け: simmered dish — the cooking method itself, can apply to fish or vegetables
